description: Five fictional cases for an initial controlled regression evaluation. These are not captured GitHub issues or a representative quality benchmark.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Reports a malfunction of existing behavior.

labels.name: docs
labels.description: Requests a change to project documentation.

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: Requests new product behavior or a new capability.

labels.name: needs-info
labels.description: Essential details needed to investigate the report are missing.

labels.name: question
labels.description: Asks how existing product behavior works.

labels.name: security
labels.description: Reports a concrete security vulnerability with supporting evidence.

cases.description: Two CSV export reports share a distinctive path condition and error.

issues.title: CSV export fails on Windows when the output folder contains non-ASCII characters
issues.body: Version 1.4.0 on Windows 11. Steps: open the sample table, choose Export CSV, and save to C:/Users/tester/Desktop/café. Expected: a CSV file. Actual: export stops with UnicodeEncodeError: 'ascii' codec can't encode character. Saving the same table to C:/Temp works. No cause or fix has been confirmed.

issues.title: CSV export UnicodeEncodeError on Windows with an accented output directory
issues.body: Version 1.4.0 on Windows 11. CSV export fails when a non-ASCII character is present in the output folder path. The error is UnicodeEncodeError: 'ascii' codec can't encode character. Export to C:/Temp succeeds. This issue was closed without a linked patch or a documented resolution.

issues.title: Toolbar icon alignment
issues.body: The help icon is two pixels lower than the settings icon. This is a visual layout report.

cases.reference_notes: Shared CSV format, Windows version, non-ASCII output path and exact error support a possible duplicate. Closure does not establish a fix or a confirmed shared root cause.
review_questions: Does the comparison cite the shared path condition and exact error rather than only the word export?
Does the answer avoid saying that closure proves a fix or a confirmed duplicate?
Are the summary and draft supported by the retrieved excerpts?

cases.description: A hosting documentation request and a hosting runtime defect share provider keywords.

issues.title: Add FreeHost deployment guide to the hosting documentation
issues.body: Please add a link to the FreeHost deployment guide in the Hosting Platforms documentation. This is a documentation listing request. I am not reporting an application error, session bug, or broken deployment. I would like maintainers to decide whether the provider belongs in that list.

issues.title: FreeHost deployment loses sessions after worker restarts
issues.body: Version 2.0 on Linux. A deployed application on FreeHost loses its session after a worker restarts because each worker is configured with a different signing key. Steps and logs demonstrate the session loss. This report asks about session configuration, not adding a provider to the hosting documentation.

comments.author: maintainer
comments.body: We have not decided whether to include this provider. Keep any proposed documentation entry factual and neutral.

cases.reference_notes: The provider and deployment context overlap, but the target requests a docs entry and the candidate reports session loss. The target does not support bug or security labels.
review_questions: Does the answer distinguish a documentation inclusion decision from a runtime session defect?
Does the reply avoid claiming that maintainers have already approved the provider?
Does the docs recommendation follow the catalog description?

cases.description: A vague export report cannot establish whether a detailed prior report is the same failure.

issues.title: Export fails
issues.body: Export does not work. I have no further details to share yet.

issues.title: Export fails with permission denied on an encrypted Linux folder
issues.body: Version 2.0 on Linux. CSV export fails with PermissionError when the destination is an encrypted read-only folder. Export to a writable folder works.

cases.reference_notes: Only a generic export symptom overlaps. The target lacks the details needed to compare conditions. Ask useful investigation questions without treating the candidate's Linux permission error as the target's confirmed cause.
review_questions: Does the answer preserve uncertainty about the operating system and error?
Do the questions request useful missing details, such as version, platform, steps or exact error?
Does the reply avoid asserting that the target has a Linux permissions problem?

cases.description: A concrete feature request has no eligible keyword matches in the fixed snapshot.

issues.title: Allow a custom keyboard shortcut for saving a document
issues.body: Please add a keyboard shortcut setting for the Save action. The current Ctrl+S shortcut works correctly. I want to choose Ctrl+Shift+S instead because of a conflict with another application. This requests a new setting, not a fix for a broken existing shortcut.

issues.title: Toolbar icon alignment
issues.body: The help icon is two pixels lower than the settings icon. This is a visual layout report.

cases.reference_notes: The snapshot contains no related shortcut issue. A successful empty search only establishes no eligible matches for the recorded queries. The existing shortcut is working; the requested setting is new behavior.
review_questions: Does the answer describe this as a new capability rather than a malfunction?
Does it limit the no-match statement to the recorded searches?
Does it avoid inventing an existing customization option or promising an implementation?

cases.description: A detailed defect report already has its supported classification label.

issues.title: PNG export writes a zero-byte image
issues.body: Version 2.1.0 on Ubuntu 24.04. Steps: create a blank document, draw a rectangle, choose Export PNG, and save to a writable local directory. Expected: an image of the rectangle. Actual: a zero-byte file and the log message PNG encoder returned no bytes. The result repeats with the bundled sample document. SVG output works. No fix or cause has been confirmed.

issues.title: Theme contrast
issues.body: The light theme needs a darker border around its navigation panel.

cases.reference_notes: Bug already describes the report. The other catalog labels are not supported by the provided details. An accepted empty recommendation is correct here, but a skipped catalog or missing final answer is not equivalent to abstention.
review_questions: Does the answer avoid repeating bug as a new suggestion?
Does it avoid inventing a security issue or a confirmed encoder root cause?
Does it use the version, platform and steps already present rather than asking for them again?
